notes.title: Update 1.2.0, and other news
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We thought we might take a moment to talk about updates and some other topics.

Earlier this week, we released a patch which added Click-To-Open to the game. This is a feature which we originally developed for "Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist", but we got some request to add it to this game as well so we took some time to do just that. If you prefer using the old interaction method, you can disable Click-To-Open from the settings menu. We also added the ability to inspect items carried by other players in multiplayer.

We still have some plans for other patches to this game, such as a small sound effect focused update, and we will let you know when they come out.

In other news, the steam store page for our next project "Escape Memoirs: Mini Stories" is now live. It is a smaller free cooperative escape-room experience. You can more find more information about it  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098350/Escape_Memoirs_Mini_Stories/]here[/url].

0 Deer Soft

notes.title: State of the game and our future plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We want to take a moment to talk to you about various topics relating to this game as well as our future projects.

First of all, we want to thank you all for your support and feedback. We are really happy that so many of you enjoy our work. 

Secondly, we thought we should compile a list of all of the notable things we have added to the game since launch thanks to your feedback and suggestions:

-Auto-Save system (this was particularly highly requested)
-Reworked hint system.
-Various optimizations, most notable when it comes to VRAM usage.

Thirdly, we want to take a moment to talk about the future of the game. We are planning on doing at least one more optimization patch as well as one small patch that is designed to slightly update the visuals of the game. Of course, we are planning on also fixing any bugs that get reported as usual.

Lastly, our next game "Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist" is coming out later this week. It is a similar co-operative escape-room style puzzle game, so if you enjoyed this game we highly recommend you check it out.

You can find it here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1925320/Escape_Memoirs_Mansion_Heist/]Escape Memoirs: Mansion Heist[/url]

With best regards,
0 Deer Soft

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Here is the change log for patch 1.1.0

Features:
-Added autosave feature. The game now automatically saves every 5 minutes into a separate autosave slot. When loading a game you can choose whether you want to load your manual save file or your autosave.
-Expanded the hint system. Now in addition to the hint vision highlighting important objects, it also now reveals hint tokens near puzzles which can clicked on to get hints related to those puzzles. These hints are not supposed to spoil the whole solution of a puzzle and instead are designed to point out things the player might have missed or not realized.
-Slightly improved how static mesh culling works, resulting in a small performance increase under certain circumstances.

Bug fixes:
-Some small fixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Here is the change log for patch 1.0.4

Puzzle adjustments:
-Adjusted the font of a specific puzzle note to make it clearer that it refers to the number zero and not the letter "O".

Bug Fixes:
-Adjusted friction calculations of moving objects to work correctly with very high frame-rates(200+).
-Added a fail-safe to the moving book case to make sure it opens fully regardless of frame-rate.
-Some small bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix for Patch 1.0.3

Here is the change log for patch 1.0.3 hotfix

Bug fixes:
-Fixed a bug where a specific bottle of diluted nitric acid was not working as intended.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Here is the change log for patch 1.0.3

General:
-Adjusted how controls are shown at the bottom-left of the screen. Now special actions such as flipping pages or turning the lamp on are shown in a different colour, which makes them easier to notice.
-Adjusted how hint vision works. Previously hint vision mainly highlighted items you had not found yet. Now it is also highlights various important objects even if you have already found them.
-Adjusted how collectible visibility works. Previously, in multiplayer collectibles were initialized based on host. Now you will be able to find all collectibles you are missing even if the host already has them. The collectibles are still granted to all players in a multiplayer session even if only one person picks them up. Additionally, resetting collectibles no longer requires you to restart the game in order for the collectibles to appear again.
-Fixed some typos. 

Puzzle Adjustments;
-Adjusted the colour of the electric blocking system for the door to A-Wing in the Main hall to make it easier to notice.
-Slightly adjusted the Knight puzzle to clarify few small details.

Bug Fixes:
-Fixed some graphical issues, such as a missing piece of geometry.
